None of these is James, and none overlaps with any ancestor of James.

No relation positions Adam in James's ancestor chain (ruling out option 2), James in Adam's descendant chain (ruling out option 1), any person as a descendant of both (ruling out option 3, further supported by zero relations listing any descendant of James), or any person as an ancestor of both (ruling out option 4, further supported by zero relations listing any ancestor of Adam). The two chains are disjoint with no bridging links, so none of the relationships 1–4 holds based on the given data.
